purpose: Define reproducible molecular-structure annotations relevant to UV-Vis electronic absorption. The schema separates raw molecular-graph facts, derived chemical semantics, heuristic electronic-context annotations, reserved Woodward-Fieser structural inputs, and reserved spectrum-derived descriptors.
design_principles: Prefer raw and continuous structural facts over premature binarization.
Separate molecular-graph facts from derived chemical semantics.
Separate deterministic structural derivations from heuristic donor-acceptor interpretations.
Do not delete rare annotations; change training_status instead.
Structure annotations must be derived only from molecular structure and must not use UV-Vis spectra.
Annotation definition and downstream training-target selection must remain separate.
Hierarchical label relationships must be retained explicitly.
Invalid molecular annotations must never be silently converted to all-zero labels.
RDKit version, aromaticity handling, source structure checksum, and builder version must be recorded for reproducibility.
RDKit conjugation perception is retained as a raw cheminformatics descriptor; UV-specific conjugation semantics are defined from the explicit uv_pi_system_graph.

current_chemistry_scope.notes: The schema is extensible, but v1.0 only activates chemistry that is relevant to the current QM9S molecular space.

annotation_validity_fields.name: annotation_valid
annotation_validity_fields.definition: 1 if all required molecular parsing and structure-annotation steps completed successfully; otherwise 0.

annotation_validity_fields.name: annotation_warning_count
annotation_validity_fields.definition: Number of non-fatal annotation warnings generated for the molecule.

annotation_validity_fields.name: annotation_error_code
annotation_validity_fields.definition: Machine-readable error code if annotation_valid is 0; empty string otherwise.

A_raw_pi_conjugation_descriptors.description: Low-level molecular-graph descriptors. RDKit conjugation descriptors are kept separate from UV-specific pi-system descriptors.

features.name: heavy_atom_count
features.definition: Number of non-hydrogen atoms in the molecule.

features.name: nonaromatic_double_bond_count
features.definition: Number of non-aromatic bonds with bond type DOUBLE.

features.name: triple_bond_count
features.definition: Number of bonds with bond type TRIPLE.

features.name: aromatic_bond_count
features.definition: Number of bonds marked aromatic by the configured RDKit aromaticity model.

features.name: explicit_unsaturated_unit_count
features.definition: Total number of explicit non-aromatic double- and triple-bond unsaturated units. Aromatic systems are not converted into an arbitrary pi-bond count.

features.name: rdkit_conjugated_bond_count
features.definition: Number of bonds for which RDKit Bond.GetIsConjugated() is true.

features.name: rdkit_conjugated_atom_count
features.definition: Number of unique heavy atoms incident to at least one RDKit-conjugated bond.

features.name: rdkit_conjugated_component_count
features.definition: Number of connected components in the RDKit-conjugated subgraph.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_component_atoms
features.definition: Maximum number of atoms in any RDKit-conjugated connected component.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_component_bonds
features.definition: Maximum number of RDKit-conjugated bonds in any RDKit-conjugated connected component.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_pi_units
features.definition: Maximum number of explicit pi units found within one RDKit-conjugated component. This is a raw cheminformatics descriptor and not the canonical UV conjugation length.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_C=C_count
features.definition: Maximum number of non-aromatic C=C units in one RDKit-conjugated component.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_C#C_count
features.definition: Maximum number of C#C units in one RDKit-conjugated component.

features.name: rdkit_longest_conjugated_path_atoms
features.definition: Number of atoms in the longest non-repeating atom path inside a RDKit-conjugated component. Graph descriptor only; not a direct physical conjugation length.

features.name: rdkit_longest_conjugated_path_bonds
features.definition: Number of bonds in the longest non-repeating bond path inside a RDKit-conjugated component. Graph descriptor only; not a direct physical conjugation length.

features.name: rdkit_fraction_conjugated_heavy_atoms
features.definition: rdkit_conjugated_atom_count divided by heavy_atom_count.

features.name: rdkit_cyclic_conjugated_component_count
features.definition: Number of RDKit-conjugated components containing at least one ring bond.

features.name: rdkit_branched_conjugated_component_count
features.definition: Number of RDKit-conjugated components containing an atom with subgraph degree at least 3.

features.name: rdkit_max_conjugated_graph_degree
features.definition: Maximum atom degree measured within the RDKit-conjugated subgraph.

features.name: rdkit_conjugated_branch_point_count
features.definition: Number of atoms with degree at least 3 within the RDKit-conjugated subgraph.

features.name: uv_pi_system_component_count
features.definition: Number of independent UV-relevant conjugated or intrinsically delocalized pi systems. An isolated non-aromatic pi unit does not count as a component. An aromatic ring system counts as one UV pi-system component.

features.name: uv_pi_system_atom_count
features.definition: Number of unique heavy atoms belonging to UV-relevant conjugated or intrinsically delocalized pi systems. Atoms belonging only to isolated non-aromatic pi units are excluded.

features.name: max_uv_pi_system_atoms
features.definition: Maximum number of unique heavy atoms participating in any one UV-relevant conjugated or intrinsically delocalized pi system.

features.name: max_uv_pi_system_units
features.definition: Maximum number of pi-system graph nodes contained in any one UV pi-system component.

features.name: fraction_uv_pi_system_heavy_atoms
features.definition: uv_pi_system_atom_count divided by heavy_atom_count; isolated non-aromatic pi units are excluded from the numerator.

features.name: max_linear_conjugated_pi_units
features.definition: Maximum number of consecutively conjugatively coupled pi-system nodes along one non-repeating valid path. Cumulated unsaturation is excluded from ordinary linear-conjugation counting.

features.name: max_linear_conjugated_C=C_units
features.definition: Maximum number of conjugatively coupled non-aromatic C=C units along one valid linear conjugated path.

features.name: max_linear_conjugated_C#C_units
features.definition: Maximum number of conjugatively coupled C#C units along one valid conjugated path.

features.name: isolated_unsaturated_unit_count
features.definition: Number of explicit non-aromatic unsaturated units not conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: isolated_alkene_count
features.definition: Number of non-aromatic C=C units not conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: isolated_alkyne_count
features.definition: Number of C#C units not conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: cumulated_unsaturation_unit_count
features.definition: Number of central-atom cumulated-unsaturation motifs in which one atom participates in two adjacent explicit multiple bonds, such as X=C=Y.

features.name: exocyclic_double_bond_count
features.definition: Number of non-aromatic double bonds that are exocyclic with respect to at least one ring.

features.name: exocyclic_ring_relation_count
features.definition: Number of double-bond-to-ring exocyclic relationships. A single double bond may contribute more than one relation in polycyclic systems.

B1_conjugation_semantics.description: Binary UV-relevant conjugation semantics derived from the explicit uv_pi_system_graph. RDKit conjugation flags are not sufficient by themselves to assign these labels.

features.name: has_conjugation
features.definition: uv_pi_system_component_count is greater than zero. This includes aromatic delocalization and non-aromatic systems containing at least two conjugatively coupled pi units.

features.name: has_nonaromatic_conjugation
features.definition: At least one valid UV pi-system component contains two or more conjugatively coupled non-aromatic pi units. Cumulated unsaturation alone does not satisfy this criterion.

features.name: isolated_unsaturation
features.definition: isolated_unsaturated_unit_count is greater than zero.

features.name: isolated_alkene
features.definition: isolated_alkene_count is greater than zero.

features.name: isolated_alkyne
features.definition: isolated_alkyne_count is greater than zero.

features.name: conjugated_diene
features.definition: At least one valid non-aromatic conjugated path contains two or more conjugatively coupled C=C units. Cumulated systems such as C=C=C do not satisfy this criterion solely by containing two adjacent double bonds.

features.name: conjugated_triene
features.definition: max_linear_conjugated_C=C_units is greater than or equal to 3.

features.name: extended_polyene
features.definition: max_linear_conjugated_C=C_units is greater than or equal to 4.

features.name: conjugated_enyne
features.definition: At least one valid conjugated path contains at least one C=C unit and at least one C#C unit.

features.name: conjugated_diyne
features.definition: At least one valid conjugated path contains two or more conjugatively coupled C#C units.

features.name: cumulated_unsaturation
features.definition: cumulated_unsaturation_unit_count is greater than zero.

features.name: acyclic_conjugated_system
features.definition: At least one UV pi-system component containing conjugative coupling contains no ring participation.

features.name: cyclic_conjugated_system
features.definition: At least one UV pi-system component contains ring participation.

features.name: branched_conjugated_system
features.definition: At least one UV pi-system component has a pi-system graph node with degree at least 3.

features.name: multiple_independent_conjugated_systems
features.definition: uv_pi_system_component_count is greater than or equal to 2.

features.name: mixed_aromatic_nonaromatic_conjugation
features.definition: A single UV pi-system component contains at least one aromatic ring-system node and at least one non-aromatic explicit pi-unit node.

features.name: cross_conjugation_candidate
features.definition: Topology is compatible with potential cross-conjugation based on branching of a non-aromatic UV pi-system graph. This is not a definitive classical cross-conjugation assignment in v1.0.

B2_aromatic_semantics.description: Descriptors and binary labels describing aromatic systems and aromatic/non-aromatic pi connectivity.

features.name: aromatic_atom_count
features.definition: Number of atoms marked aromatic by the configured RDKit default aromaticity model.

features.name: aromatic_ring_count
features.definition: Number of aromatic rings enumerated using RDKit SymmSSSR under the recorded RDKit default aromaticity model.

features.name: aromatic_system_count
features.definition: Number of independent aromatic ring systems. Aromatic rings fused by sharing at least one ring bond belong to the same system; aromatic rings connected only through a non-ring single bond belong to separate systems.

features.name: largest_aromatic_system_atoms
features.definition: Number of unique aromatic atoms in the largest aromatic ring system.

features.name: largest_aromatic_system_rings
features.definition: Number of RDKit SymmSSSR aromatic rings in the largest aromatic ring system.

features.name: fused_aromatic_ring_system_count
features.definition: Number of aromatic ring systems containing at least two aromatic rings fused by sharing at least one ring bond.

features.name: biaryl_single_bond_link_count
features.definition: Number of non-ring single bonds directly linking atoms belonging to two distinct aromatic ring systems.

features.name: pyridine_like_aromatic_N_count
features.definition: Number of aromatic nitrogen atoms whose lone pair is not required for the aromatic sextet (pyridine-like aromatic N).
features.notes: Builder implementation must use an explicit RDKit atom-state/SMARTS rule and dedicated test molecules; do not infer this class from element identity alone.

features.name: pyrrole_like_aromatic_N_count
features.definition: Number of aromatic nitrogen atoms whose lone pair contributes to the aromatic sextet (pyrrole-like aromatic N).
features.notes: Builder implementation must use an explicit RDKit atom-state/SMARTS rule and dedicated test molecules; do not infer this class from element identity alone.

features.name: has_aromatic_system
features.definition: aromatic_ring_count is greater than zero.

features.name: single_aromatic_ring
features.definition: aromatic_ring_count equals 1.

features.name: multiple_aromatic_rings
features.definition: aromatic_ring_count is greater than or equal to 2.

features.name: multiple_independent_aromatic_systems
features.definition: aromatic_system_count is greater than or equal to 2.

features.name: fused_aromatic_system
features.definition: fused_aromatic_ring_system_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_biaryl_single_bond_link
features.definition: biaryl_single_bond_link_count is greater than zero.

features.name: carbocyclic_aromatic
features.definition: At least one aromatic ring system consists exclusively of carbon aromatic atoms.

features.name: heteroaromatic
features.definition: At least one aromatic ring system contains an aromatic atom other than carbon.

features.name: N_heteroaromatic
features.definition: At least one aromatic nitrogen atom is present.

features.name: O_heteroaromatic
features.definition: At least one aromatic oxygen atom is present.

features.name: has_pyridine_like_aromatic_N
features.definition: pyridine_like_aromatic_N_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_pyrrole_like_aromatic_N
features.definition: pyrrole_like_aromatic_N_count is greater than zero.

features.name: aromatic_to_nonaromatic_pi_conjugation
features.definition: An aromatic ring-system node and at least one non-aromatic explicit pi-unit node occur in the same UV pi-system component and are connected by a valid conjugative-coupling path.

features.name: carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carbonyl C=O motifs.

features.name: isolated_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carbonyl groups that are externally nonconjugated, meaning they are not coupled to an additional external pi unit or aromatic ring system. Intrinsic ester/amide resonance does not disqualify this label.
features.notes: In v1.0, 'isolated_carbonyl' means externally nonconjugated carbonyl.

features.name: pi_conjugated_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carbonyl groups externally conjugatively coupled to at least one additional pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: aldehyde_count
features.definition: Number of aldehyde carbonyl motifs.

features.name: ketone_count
features.definition: Number of ketone carbonyl motifs.

features.name: ester_count
features.definition: Number of ester carbonyl motifs.

features.name: amide_count
features.definition: Number of amide carbonyl motifs.

features.name: carboxylic_acid_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carboxylic-acid carbonyl motifs.

features.name: acyl_fluoride_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of acyl-fluoride carbonyl motifs.

features.name: anhydride_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carbonyl motifs belonging to carboxylic anhydrides.

features.name: other_carbonyl_count
features.definition: Number of carbonyl motifs not assigned to the explicitly enumerated carbonyl subclasses in schema v1.0. This is an audit field intended to reveal missing motif classes.

features.name: max_carbonyl_conjugated_C=C_path_count
features.definition: Maximum number of sequentially conjugatively coupled C=C units reachable from a carbonyl pi unit along one valid UV pi-system path.

features.name: has_carbonyl
features.definition: carbonyl_count is greater than zero.

features.name: isolated_carbonyl
features.definition: isolated_carbonyl_count is greater than zero. Here 'isolated' means externally nonconjugated; intrinsic ester/amide resonance is not counted as external conjugation.

features.name: pi_conjugated_carbonyl
features.definition: pi_conjugated_carbonyl_count is greater than zero.

features.name: alpha_beta_unsaturated_carbonyl
features.definition: At least one carbonyl pi unit is followed along a valid conjugated path by at least one C=C unit; equivalently max_carbonyl_conjugated_C=C_path_count is at least 1.

features.name: extended_unsaturated_carbonyl
features.definition: At least one carbonyl-centered conjugated path contains two or more sequentially coupled C=C units; equivalently max_carbonyl_conjugated_C=C_path_count is at least 2.

features.name: aryl_carbonyl
features.definition: At least one carbonyl pi unit is directly conjugatively coupled to an aromatic ring system.

features.name: conjugated_aldehyde
features.definition: At least one aldehyde carbonyl is externally conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: conjugated_ketone
features.definition: At least one ketone carbonyl is externally conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: pi_extended_ester
features.definition: At least one ester carbonyl participates in an additional external pi or aromatic conjugated system beyond intrinsic ester resonance.

features.name: pi_extended_amide
features.definition: At least one amide carbonyl participates in an additional external pi or aromatic conjugated system beyond intrinsic amide resonance.

B4_nitrogen_chromophore_semantics.description: Nitrogen-containing unsaturated and UV-relevant structural environments.

features.name: imine_count
features.definition: Number of non-aromatic C=N motifs.

features.name: isolated_imine_count
features.definition: Number of C=N units not externally conjugatively coupled to another pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: pi_conjugated_imine_count
features.definition: Number of C=N units externally conjugatively coupled to at least one additional pi unit or aromatic ring system.

features.name: nitrile_count
features.definition: Number of C#N motifs.

features.name: isolated_nitrile_count
features.definition: Number of nitrile groups whose carbon atom is not conjugatively coupled to an additional pi or aromatic system.

features.name: pi_conjugated_nitrile_count
features.definition: Number of nitrile groups whose carbon atom is conjugatively coupled to an additional pi or aromatic system.

features.name: nitro_count
features.definition: Number of nitro-group motifs.

features.name: pi_conjugated_nitro_count
features.definition: Number of nitro groups directly attached to a UV pi-system framework in a topology compatible with conjugative interaction. This is a 2D structural annotation and does not imply a quantified conjugation strength.

features.name: NN_double_bond_count
features.definition: Number of explicit N=N double bonds.

features.name: has_imine
features.definition: imine_count is greater than zero.

features.name: isolated_imine
features.definition: isolated_imine_count is greater than zero.

features.name: pi_conjugated_imine
features.definition: pi_conjugated_imine_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_nitrile
features.definition: nitrile_count is greater than zero.

features.name: isolated_nitrile
features.definition: isolated_nitrile_count is greater than zero.

features.name: pi_conjugated_nitrile
features.definition: pi_conjugated_nitrile_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_nitro
features.definition: nitro_count is greater than zero.

features.name: pi_conjugated_nitro
features.definition: pi_conjugated_nitro_count is greater than zero. This is a 2D structural topology label, not a quantitative statement about effective conjugation strength.

features.name: has_NN_double_bond
features.definition: NN_double_bond_count is greater than zero.

B5_auxochrome_and_electronic_context.description: Strict structural attachment facts plus explicitly marked donor-acceptor heuristics. Heteroatom attachment requires single-bond connection to the pi-system framework and excludes heteroatoms that are themselves part of the target pi unit.

features.name: lone_pair_O_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of oxygen substituents connected through a SINGLE bond to a UV pi-system atom, where the oxygen is not itself part of the target pi unit and is not an acyl oxygen directly bonded to a carbonyl carbon.

features.name: hydroxy_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of hydroxy oxygens connected through a SINGLE bond to a UV pi-system atom, excluding carboxylic-acid/acyl hydroxy oxygen directly bonded to a carbonyl carbon.

features.name: alkoxy_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of non-acyl ether-like or alkoxy oxygens connected through a SINGLE bond to a UV pi-system atom. Ester/acyl oxygen directly bonded to a carbonyl carbon is excluded.

features.name: N_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of nitrogen atoms connected through a SINGLE bond to a UV pi-system atom while not being the atom that defines the target pi unit itself.

features.name: lone_pair_donor_N_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of donor-capable nitrogen substituents connected through a SINGLE bond to a UV pi-system atom. Amide-like N, imine N, nitrile N, nitro N, and formal-positive/quaternary N are excluded.

features.name: fluorine_pi_attachment_count
features.definition: Number of fluorine atoms directly attached to atoms belonging to a UV pi-system component.

features.name: donor_attachment_count
features.definition: Total number of v1.0 donor-like attachments associated with UV pi-system components, defined from hydroxy, alkoxy, and lone-pair-donor nitrogen attachments.

features.name: acceptor_attachment_count
features.definition: Total number of v1.0 acceptor-like motifs associated with UV pi-system components, defined from externally pi-conjugated carbonyl, nitrile, and nitro motifs.

features.name: donor_acceptor_pair_count_same_system
features.definition: Number of donor-like/acceptor-like attachment pairs associated with the same UV pi-system component.

features.name: min_donor_acceptor_pi_path_distance
features.definition: Minimum shortest-path length, measured in UV pi-system graph edges, between a pi-system node bearing a donor-like attachment and a pi-system node bearing an acceptor-like attachment within the same component. Use -1 when no valid donor-acceptor pair exists. Reserved in schema v1.0 because aromatic ring systems are compressed at the system level; a future atom-level positional pi framework is required for meaningful ortho/meta/para-sensitive distances.

features.name: max_donor_acceptor_pi_path_distance
features.definition: Maximum shortest-path length, measured in UV pi-system graph edges, among valid donor-acceptor pairs within the same UV pi-system component. Use -1 when no valid donor-acceptor pair exists. Reserved in schema v1.0 because aromatic ring systems are compressed at the system level; a future atom-level positional pi framework is required for meaningful ortho/meta/para-sensitive distances.

features.name: lone_pair_O_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: lone_pair_O_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: hydroxy_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: hydroxy_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: alkoxy_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: alkoxy_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: N_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: N_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: lone_pair_donor_N_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: lone_pair_donor_N_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: fluorine_attached_to_pi_system
features.definition: fluorine_pi_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_donor_substituted_pi_system
features.definition: donor_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: has_acceptor_substituted_pi_system
features.definition: acceptor_attachment_count is greater than zero.

features.name: donor_acceptor_same_conjugated_system
features.definition: At least one donor-like and one acceptor-like motif are associated with the same UV pi-system component.
features.notes: Topology-based heuristic only; it must not automatically be interpreted as a quantitatively established D-pi-A electronic system.

C_woodward_fieser_reserved.description: Reserved structural inputs for a later Woodward-Fieser / Fieser-Kuhn rule engine. These are defined in schema v1.0 but not implemented in the first structure-annotation builder.

D_uv_spectral_descriptors_reserved.description: Reserved descriptors derived from UV-Vis spectra. These must remain physically separated from molecular-structure ground-truth annotations.
D_uv_spectral_descriptors_reserved.data_leakage_policy: These descriptors must never be used as structural ground-truth targets in the spectrum-to-structure semantic prediction task.

consistency_rules.rule: cumulated_unsaturation alone must not imply conjugated_diene

training_target_selection_policy.rare_label_policy: Rare annotations are retained in the annotation table and moved to reserved status rather than deleted.
training_target_selection_policy.canonical_training_policy: Annotation availability does not imply that every annotation must be used as a training target.

revision_notes: Separate RDKit conjugation perception from UV-specific chemical conjugation semantics.
Introduce an explicit UV pi-system graph for diene/polyene/enyne/diyne and extended-conjugation semantics.
Prevent cumulated unsaturation such as C=C=C from being counted automatically as an ordinary conjugated diene.
Fix aromatic ring-system reproducibility by specifying RDKit SymmSSSR and the RDKit default aromaticity model.
Replace ambiguous or duplicate pi-attachment labels with non-redundant, chemically explicit annotations.
Tighten O/N auxochrome definitions and separate structural attachment facts from donor/acceptor heuristics.
Promote motif counts and path-length descriptors as reusable low-level facts from which binary labels can be regenerated.

molecular_processing_policy.policy_note: The annotated molecular identity must remain the structure paired with the spectrum. No chemistry-changing standardization is permitted before annotation.

rdkit_conjugated_subgraph.definition: Subgraph formed from bonds for which RDKit Bond.GetIsConjugated() is true and their endpoint atoms.
rdkit_conjugated_subgraph.role: Raw cheminformatics descriptor only. It must not by itself define UV-specific diene, triene, polyene, enyne, diyne, or extended-conjugation semantic labels.

uv_pi_system_graph.definition: Canonical 2D chemical-semantic graph used for UV-specific conjugation labels. Aromatic ring systems are treated as intrinsically delocalized UV pi systems. Non-aromatic pi units are included only when they participate in a coupled conjugated system; isolated non-aromatic pi units are tracked separately and do not create singleton UV pi-system components.
node_rules: Aromatic ring system: one delocalized aromatic-system node.
Non-aromatic pi unit: explicit C=C, C#C, C=O, C=N, N=N, or C#N motif when chemically relevant.
Cumulated motifs sharing a central atom, such as C=C=C, are recorded as cumulated_unsaturation and are not treated as ordinary linear conjugated diene/polyene paths.
edge_rules: Connect two non-aromatic pi units when they form an uninterrupted alternating conjugated path without an sp3 interruption.
Connect an aromatic ring system to a directly attached exocyclic non-aromatic pi unit when the attachment provides a continuous conjugative path.
Do not merge two aromatic ring systems connected only by a non-ring single bond; record that relation separately with biaryl_single_bond_link_count.
Do not create ordinary conjugation edges solely because two multiple bonds share the same central atom in a cumulated system.
uv_pi_system_graph.role: Canonical graph for diene/polyene/enyne/diyne labels, conjugated-system counts, aromatic/non-aromatic coupling, carbonyl/nitrile/imine/nitro structural conjugation, and coarse donor-acceptor system membership.

freeze_policy: This file is the frozen Annotation Schema v1.0. Future additions or semantic changes must be introduced in v1.1 or later; v1.0 field meanings must not be silently changed.

implementation_policy_v1.rule: Do not add new v1.0 fields during builder implementation. If a genuinely new annotation is later required, introduce it in schema v1.1.
